package main

import (
 "context"
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "sort"
 "strings"

 "golang.org/x/sys/unix"
 "retrom/internal/capability/engine/scummvm"
)
const commit = "fed42f2068dcafc6aafa1c28c77e4c88def74b66"
var resolverFailure = errors.New("capture resolver failure")
var sandbox string
var sourceDigest = strings.Repeat("a",64)
type controlledContext struct { context.Context; done chan struct{}; outcome error }
func (ctx *controlledContext) Done() <-chan struct{} { return ctx.done }
func (ctx *controlledContext) Err() error { select { case <-ctx.done:return ctx.outcome;default:return nil } }
func sum(contents []byte) string { digest:=sha256.Sum256(contents);return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]) }
func raw(value any) []byte { b,err:=json.Marshal(value);if err!=nil{panic(err)};return b }
func errorFacts(err error) map[string]any {
 text,kind:="","";if err!=nil{text=err.Error();kind=fmt.Sprintf("%T",err)}
 text=strings.ReplaceAll(text,sandbox,"<sandbox>")
 return map[string]any{"text":text,"type":kind,"tool":errors.Is(err,scummvm.ErrToolFailed),"input":errors.Is(err,scummvm.ErrInputInvalid),"limit":errors.Is(err,scummvm.ErrLimit),"result":errors.Is(err,scummvm.ErrResultInvalid),"canceled":errors.Is(err,context.Canceled),"deadline":errors.Is(err,context.DeadlineExceeded),"resolver":errors.Is(err,resolverFailure),"notExist":errors.Is(err,os.ErrNotExist)}
}
func encoded(value any) map[string]any { contents:=raw(value);return map[string]any{"json":string(contents),"sha256":sum(contents)} }
func game(root,language string) scummvm.DetectedGame { return scummvm.DetectedGame{Root:root,EngineID:"sky",GameID:"sky",Description:"Fixture <&> 游戏",PreferredTarget:"sky",Language:language,Platform:"pc",Extra:"Floppy",GUIOptions:"",Config:map[string]string{},CanBeAdded:true} }
func response(candidates []scummvm.DetectedGame) []byte { return raw(map[string]any{"schemaVersion":1,"upstreamCommit":commit,"candidates":candidates,"error":nil}) }
func child() {
 var root,save string
 for _,arg:=range os.Args[1:] {if strings.HasPrefix(arg,"--path="){root=strings.TrimPrefix(arg,"--path=")};if strings.HasPrefix(arg,"--savepath="){save=strings.TrimPrefix(arg,"--savepath=")}}
 parent:=filepath.Dir(root)
 mode,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(parent,"mode"));if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 env:=os.Environ();sort.Strings(env)
 cwd,err:=os.Getwd();if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 args:=append([]string(nil),os.Args[1:]...)
 for i,arg:=range args{args[i]=strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(arg,root,"<input>"),save,"<run>")}
 normalizedEnv:=make([]string,len(env));for i,v:=range env{normalizedEnv[i]=strings.ReplaceAll(v,save,"<run>")}
 audit:=map[string]any{"args":args,"env":normalizedEnv,"cwdIsSavepath":cwd==save,"homeIsSavepath":os.Getenv("HOME")==save,"xdgIsSavepath":os.Getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")==save,"directoryMode":0}
 info,err:=os.Stat(save);if err!=nil{panic(err)};audit["directoryMode"]=uint32(info.Mode().Perm())
 if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(parent,"invocation.json"),raw(audit),0600);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 switch string(mode) {
 case "cancel","deadline":
  blocker,err:=os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(parent,"block"),os.O_RDWR,0600);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
  ready,err:=os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(parent,"ready"),os.O_WRONLY,0600);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
  if _,err:=ready.Write([]byte("R"));err!=nil{panic(err)};if err:=ready.Close();err!=nil{panic(err)}
  if _,err:=blocker.Read(make([]byte,1));err!=nil{panic(err)}
  panic("blocking helper unexpectedly resumed")
 case "stdout-limit":
  _,_ = os.Stdout.Write([]byte(strings.Repeat("x",16*1024*1024+1)));os.Exit(7)
 case "stderr-limit":
  _,_ = os.Stderr.Write([]byte(strings.Repeat("diagnostic",7000)))
 }
 contents,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(parent,"response.json"));if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if _,err:=os.Stdout.Write(contents);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if string(mode)=="exit7"{os.Exit(7)}
}
type scenario struct { name string; contents []byte; mode,rootKind,toolKind,digest string; canceled,resolverError,cancelInResolver,badTemporary bool; engines []string }
func observe(test scenario, index int) map[string]any {
 parent:=filepath.Join(sandbox,fmt.Sprintf("case-%03d",index));if err:=os.Mkdir(parent,0700);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 root:=filepath.Join(parent,"input");if err:=os.Mkdir(root,0700);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root,"public.txt"),[]byte("public fixture"),0400);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if test.contents==nil{test.contents=response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{game("Game","en")})}
 for name,contents:=range map[string][]byte{"mode":[]byte(test.mode),"response.json":test.contents}{if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(parent,name),contents,0600);err!=nil{panic(err)}}
 switch test.rootKind {
 case "relative":root="relative"
 case "missing":root=filepath.Join(parent,"missing")
 case "regular":root=filepath.Join(root,"public.txt")
 case "symlink-root":target:=root;root=filepath.Join(parent,"link");if err:=os.Symlink(target,root);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 case "nested-symlink":if err:=os.Symlink(filepath.Join(root,"public.txt"),filepath.Join(root,"link"));err!=nil{panic(err)}
 case "fifo":if err:=unix.Mkfifo(filepath.Join(root,"fifo"),0600);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 }
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithCancel(context.Background());defer cancel()
 var active context.Context=ctx
 if test.canceled{cancel()}
 readyResult:=make(chan error,1)
 if test.mode=="cancel"||test.mode=="deadline" {
  for _,name:=range []string{"ready","block"} {if err:=unix.Mkfifo(filepath.Join(parent,name),0600);err!=nil{panic(err)}}
  manual:=&controlledContext{Context:context.Background(),done:make(chan struct{}),outcome:context.Canceled}
  if test.mode=="deadline"{manual.outcome=context.DeadlineExceeded};active=manual
  go func(){
   ready,err:=os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(parent,"ready"),os.O_RDONLY,0600);if err!=nil{readyResult<-err;return}
   b:=make([]byte,1);_,err=ready.Read(b);closeErr:=ready.Close();close(manual.done);readyResult<-errors.Join(err,closeErr)
  }()
 }
 calls:=0
 executable,err:=os.Executable();if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 engines:=test.engines;if engines==nil{engines=[]string{"sky"}}
 detector:=scummvm.New(func(context.Context)(scummvm.Tool,error){
  calls++;if test.cancelInResolver{cancel()};if test.resolverError{return scummvm.Tool{},resolverFailure}
  tool:=scummvm.Tool{Path:executable,UpstreamCommit:commit,Engines:engines}
  switch test.toolKind{case "relative":tool.Path="relative";case "bad-commit":tool.UpstreamCommit=strings.Repeat("A",40);case "empty-engines":tool.Engines=nil;case "missing":tool.Path=filepath.Join(parent,"missing-executable")}
  return tool,nil
 })
 temporary:=filepath.Join(sandbox,"temporary")
 if test.badTemporary{temporary=filepath.Join(parent,"missing-temporary")}
 if err:=os.Setenv("TMPDIR",temporary);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 digest:=test.digest;if digest==""{digest=sourceDigest}
 result,err:=detector.Detect(active,root,digest)
 if test.mode=="cancel"||test.mode=="deadline"{if signalErr:=<-readyResult;signalErr!=nil{panic(signalErr)}}
 record:=map[string]any{"error":errorFacts(err),"result":encoded(result),"resolverCalls":calls,"inputJSON":string(test.contents)}
 if contents,readErr:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(parent,"invocation.json"));readErr==nil{var audit map[string]any;if err:=json.Unmarshal(contents,&audit);err!=nil{panic(err)};record["invocation"]=audit}
 entries,readErr:=os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(sandbox,"temporary"));if readErr!=nil{panic(readErr)};record["temporaryEmpty"]=len(entries)==0
 if err==nil {
  snapshot,snapshotErr:=scummvm.NewSnapshot(result)
  record["snapshotError"]=errorFacts(snapshotErr);record["snapshot"]=encoded(snapshot)
  if snapshotErr==nil{
   state,code:=snapshot.Status();record["status"]=[]string{state,code}
   selected,selectionErr:=snapshot.Selected();record["selected"]=encoded(selected);record["selectionError"]=errorFacts(selectionErr)
   parsed,parseErr:=scummvm.ParseSnapshot(string(raw(snapshot)));record["reparsed"]=encoded(parsed);record["reparseError"]=errorFacts(parseErr)
   selections:=map[string]any{}
   for _,candidate:=range result.Candidates {value,e:=snapshot.Select(candidate.ID);selections[candidate.ID]=map[string]any{"snapshot":encoded(value),"error":errorFacts(e)}}
   record["selections"]=selections
  }
 }
 return record
}
func main(){
 if len(os.Args)>1&&os.Args[1]=="--config=/dev/null"{child();return}
 base,err:=filepath.Abs(".cache/refactor/scummvm-old-golden");if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 sandbox,err=os.MkdirTemp(base,"capture-");if err!=nil{panic(err)};defer os.RemoveAll(sandbox)
 if err:=os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(sandbox,"temporary"),0700);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 valid:=game("Game","en")
 tests:=[]scenario{
  {name:"single"},{name:"empty",contents:response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{})},
  {name:"ambiguous-language",contents:response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{game("Game","en"),game("Game","de")})},
  {name:"multiple-roots",contents:response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{game("Z","en"),game("A","en")})},
  {name:"engine-unavailable",engines:[]string{"queen"}},{name:"source-digest-identity",digest:strings.Repeat("b",64)},
  {name:"invalid-digest-first",digest:"bad",rootKind:"missing",resolverError:true,canceled:true},
  {name:"invalid-root-before-cancel",rootKind:"missing",canceled:true},
  {name:"canceled-tree",canceled:true},{name:"resolver-error",resolverError:true},
  {name:"relative-root",rootKind:"relative"},{name:"regular-root",rootKind:"regular"},{name:"symlink-root",rootKind:"symlink-root"},
  {name:"nested-symlink",rootKind:"nested-symlink"},{name:"special-file",rootKind:"fifo"},
  {name:"relative-tool",toolKind:"relative"},{name:"invalid-tool-commit",toolKind:"bad-commit"},{name:"empty-tool-engines",toolKind:"empty-engines"},
  {name:"missing-executable",toolKind:"missing"},{name:"tool-exit-7",mode:"exit7"},
  {name:"stderr-overflow",mode:"stderr-limit"},{name:"stdout-overflow-precedes-exit",mode:"stdout-limit"},
  {name:"cancel-after-start",mode:"cancel"},{name:"deadline-after-start",mode:"deadline"},
  {name:"cancel-in-resolver",cancelInResolver:true},
  {name:"temporary-failure-before-cancel",cancelInResolver:true,badTemporary:true},
  {name:"invalid-json",contents:[]byte("{")},
  {name:"trailing-json",contents:append(response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid}),[]byte(" {}")...)},
  {name:"unknown-top-level",contents:[]byte(strings.Replace(string(response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid})),"\"candidates\":","\"unknown\":1,\"candidates\":",1))},
  {name:"null-candidates",contents:response(nil)},
  {name:"duplicate-candidates",contents:response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid,valid})},
  {name:"raw-commit-mismatch",contents:[]byte(strings.ReplaceAll(string(response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid})),commit,strings.Repeat("b",40)))},
  {name:"raw-error-field",contents:[]byte(strings.Replace(string(response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid})),"\"error\":null","\"error\":\"upstream-failure\"",1))},
  {name:"duplicate-json-key-last-wins",contents:[]byte(strings.Replace(string(response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid})),"\"schemaVersion\":1","\"schemaVersion\":2,\"schemaVersion\":1",1))},
  {name:"trailing-whitespace",contents:append(response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid}),[]byte("  \n\t")...)},
  {name:"invalid-utf8-description",contents:[]byte(strings.Replace(string(response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{valid})),"游戏",string([]byte{0xff}),1))},

 }
 for _,name:=range []string{"unknown-variant","not-addable","addon","unsupported-level","unknown-priority","unsafe-root","unsafe-filename","nil-config","unknown-config","hint-control","root-over-limit","language-over-limit","description-over-limit","filename-over-limit","invalid-engine","invalid-game","support-over-limit"} {
  candidate:=game("Game","en")
  switch name {
  case "unknown-variant":candidate.HasUnknownFiles=true
  case "not-addable":candidate.CanBeAdded=false
  case "addon":candidate.IsAddOn=true
  case "unsupported-level":candidate.SupportLevel=3
  case "unknown-priority":candidate.HasUnknownFiles=true;candidate.CanBeAdded=false
  case "unsafe-root":candidate.Root="../escape"
  case "unsafe-filename":candidate.Config["filename"]="../escape"
  case "nil-config":candidate.Config=nil
  case "unknown-config":candidate.Config["arbitrary"]="yes"
  case "hint-control":candidate.Description="bad\ncontrol"
  case "root-over-limit":candidate.Root=strings.Repeat("x",2049)
  case "language-over-limit":candidate.Language=strings.Repeat("x",129)
  case "description-over-limit":candidate.Description=strings.Repeat("x",4097)
  case "filename-over-limit":candidate.Config["filename"]=strings.Repeat("x",241)
  case "invalid-engine":candidate.EngineID="UPPER"
  case "invalid-game":candidate.GameID="with space"
  case "support-over-limit":candidate.SupportLevel=5
  }
  tests=append(tests,scenario{name:name,contents:response([]scummvm.DetectedGame{candidate})})
 }
 results:=map[string]any{}
 for i,test:=range tests {results[test.name]=observe(test,i)}
 sources:=map[string]string{}
 for _,path:=range []string{"internal/capability/engine/scummvm/detector.go","internal/capability/engine/scummvm/result.go","internal/capability/engine/scummvm/snapshot.go","internal/service/libraryimport/scummvm_materialize.go","internal/adapter/runtime/runtimeprovider/scummvm.go"} {contents,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{panic(e)};sources[path]=sum(contents)}
 contents,err:=json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"cases":results,"sourceSHA256":sources,"purpose":"Actual old Go API execution, deterministic public byte helper process; barrier cancellation, no private games/BIOS or external downloads","wallClockBusinessWaitUsed":false},"","  ");if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 output:="/home/cgd/workspace/retrom-project/td/refactor-execution/rf04-scummvm-old-go-golden.json"
 if err:=os.WriteFile(output,append(contents,'\n'),0644);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 fmt.Printf("cases=%d sha256=%s output=%s\n",len(results),sum(append(contents,'\n')),output)
}
